summary: Backend pytest 28/28 PASS after migrating to Bearer-token shape. Frontend E2E partially validated via Playwright: admin login -> /app dashboard, Cerrar sesión clears token, refresh stays unauthenticated, RoleGuard blocks medico from /app/upload. Register flow & paciente upload could not be exercised by my Playwright script because form inputs lack name= attributes and role uses card-buttons (not select); core backend register/upload paths are however fully covered by pytest including new {user, access_token, token_type} shape.

minor.issue: allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False is consistent with new Bearer flow; cookies still set but unused by browser. OK.

ui_bugs.issue: Inputs lack name attributes and data-testid, making automated testing brittle. Add data-testid=role-paciente|clinica|medico, full-name-input, email-input, password-input, phone-input, register-submit
Inputs lack data-testid. Add login-email-input, login-password-input, login-submit.
Add data-testid=patient-name-input, doctor-select, file-input, upload-submit, study-row, study-download-btn for reliable testing.

issues: Heading reads 'Hola, Dr.' (full_name renders blank space) — likely the medico full_name interpolation cuts at first word. Verify Dashboard.jsx uses user.full_name not split.

action_items: Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements per list above (Login, Register, Upload, Studies, DashboardLayout logout button).
Verify Dashboard greeting renders full user.full_name (admin shows 'Hola, Dr.' with no name).
Optional: use a real <select name='doctor_id'> or expose data-testid='doctor-select' so e2e can pick a doctor.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend AuthResponse correctly returns {user, access_token, token_type='bearer'}; get_current_user accepts both cookie and Authorization Bearer header — verified via pytest.
axios interceptor + tokenStore (localStorage) flow works: admin login persists session and survives navigation; logout clears it.
RoleGuard works: medico hitting /app/upload is redirected to /app.
Forms lack data-testid and name attributes — adds friction for automated testing.

success_rate.frontend: Login/Logout/RoleGuard PASS; Register & Upload not automatable due to missing testids

seed_data_creation: Pytest creates TEST_pac_*, TEST_cli_*, TEST_med_* users and uploads test studies (cleaned at end). Admin seeded by backend startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend Bearer-token flow fully covered. To complete frontend e2e, main agent should add data-testid attributes; then re-run a targeted Playwright script for register-paciente -> /app/upload -> /app/studies -> medico download.
